title: ActiveMQ (AMQP 1.0) connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One ActiveMQ Artemis or Classic instance's settings over AMQP 1.0 (CN2 Task 18, OR-22, loams_connector_brokers::amqp10). JMS providers that do not speak AMQP 1.0 use the Camel `jms` fallback instead (OR-4). Deliveries stay unsettled until the Fabric acknowledges them.

username.description: The SASL PLAIN user name (not a secret); without it, SASL ANONYMOUS.

password.description: The SASL PLAIN password. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

tls.description: TLS settings: a CA bundle to trust instead of the webpki roots, and a client certificate for mTLS.

cert_pem.description: PEM client certificate chain for mTLS (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client's PEM private key, for mTLS. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

source.description: The source: addresses to receive from.

addresses.description: Addresses (queues; on Service Bus also <topic>/Subscriptions/<subscription>); one split each.

credit.description: Link credit; by default the pipeline's in-flight budget.

max_batch.description: Messages per batch at most (the pipeline's budget may be smaller).

poll_wait_ms.description: How long one read waits for the first message before reporting nothing.

sink.description: The sink: the address to send to.

send_timeout_ms.description: How long a batch waits for its outcomes.

pipeline.description: The SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (`PipelineConfig::with_overrides`): max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms and retry. The broker-side window (prefetch, credit, Receive Maximum, max_ack_pending, receiver queue) is derived from them unless set.
